name: Trade watch recap (Oct 29), one long Premium post

posts.text:
Trade watch went up on The Cupcake Index on Oct 22. Three NFL trades have happened since, and all three players were on our list.

DeForest Buckner sat at #2 for six straight days with the 49ers as his top fit. He went to San Francisco on Oct 27.

Quenton Nelson stayed in our top 7 all week, with Seattle one of his three best fits from the first list. The Seahawks got him Oct 27.

Jeffery Simmons was on the list all week too. We missed on the team: Chicago only showed up as a fit the day of the deal.

Who's next? Our five most likely to move before the Nov 10 deadline, with each one's top fit:

1. Khalil Mack (LAC): Bears
2. Jonathan Taylor (IND): Vikings
3. Brian Thomas Jr. (JAX): Steelers
4. Josh Downs (IND): Steelers
5. Garrett Wilson (NYJ): Chiefs

Who are we missing?
